name: AI Agent Memory
description: Persists AI agent state across conversation turns so agents retain tool-call history and context.
project_description: AI Agent Memory makes AI agents built on the Drupal AI stack retain their state across the turns of a chat conversation. By default the AI Assistant API's AgentRunner discards a serialized agent's state once the agent finishes a turn, so every new user message starts a completely fresh run with no memory of previous tool calls, tool results, or reasoning. This module decorates the AgentRunner and, for a configurable allow-list of agents, keeps the agent's state in a dedicated private temp-store bin that survives between turns. The next user message then resumes the agent with full context instead of a blank slate, enabling coherent multi-step workflows where each step builds on the last. The context window is kept bounded by a turn-aware history trimmer that drops middle turns while preserving the first turn and the most recent turns, and binary file data is stripped from messages before persistence to work around an upstream serialization limitation. It requires the ai, ai_agents, and ai_assistant_api projects and is configured at /admin/config/ai/agent-memory.
